description:
Device control and Media output
Kind of a hub in notification panel for managing medias played on smart devices (e.g play music to 2 Bluetooth devices simultaneously with Dual audio)
https://www.samsung.com/latin_en/support/mobile-devices/media-and-device-feature/
Has a lot of permissions and asks for ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.
WARNING: Removing this package does not prevent you to connect to smart devices, but causes the brightness slider in the notification panel to only be displayed in expanded state (as of OneUI 6).
